title: sre-weekly-ops-sync-notes-2026-03-10-draft
content:
Weekly ops sync + reliability review (draft) - 2026-03-10
Owner: Priya Raman (eng-sre)
Attendees (planned): Priya, Liam, Sofie, Aisha, on-call rotation
Status: draft notes / prep for sync

Agenda (30m)
- Quick SLO snapshot (5m)
- Paging trends & on-call load (7m)
- Top incidents since last sync (10m)
- Risk review: upcoming deploys / capacity (5m)
- Action items & blockers (3m)

SLO snapshot (top-level)
- API availability SLO (region-global): 99.95% monthly target
  - Last 30d: 99.88% (miss). Primary contributor: 2026-03-04 DB failover + 2026-03-08 tail-latency spikes
- P99 latency (generation api): target <= 350ms
  - Last 7d: 420ms (p99). Notable spike on 2026-03-08 during high-traffic burst (large-batch jobs)
- Embeddings throughput SLO: 10k req/min sustained for Dedicated pool (target: 99% availability)
  - Last 7d: 99.7% (OK)

Paging trends / on-call load
- Weekly pages (last 4 weeks): 18, 21, 25, 28 (up ~12% WoW)
  - Increase driven by: noisy alerts from k8s node terminations (AWS AZ flaps) and higher error rates from canary model rollout
- Pages by category (approx): infra 40%, runtime 35%, application 20%, monitoring false-positives 5%
- Median time to acknowledge: 4m (target <5m) — good
- Median time to resolution: 75m (target <60m) — slipped. Root causes: investigation handoffs, limited runbook coverage for model-variant rollbacks

Top incidents since last sync
1) INC-2345 (2026-03-04) - cross-region DB failover impact
   - Summary: Primary metadata DB failed during maintenance window; failover caused short window of 5xx for model metadata requests; cache cold-start amplified errors on serving nodes
   - Impact: ~12 minutes of elevated error rate, burst of retries increased CPU on serving nodes, several pages during incident
   - Current status: postmortem draft in Confluence (linked). Action: add pre-failover cache-warm job + adjust maintenance windows
   - Owner: Liam O'Connor (follow-up)
2) High p99 generation latency (2026-03-08) - canary rollout of quantized model
   - Summary: Canary rollout for v2-quantized triggered memory pressure + increased GC on some runtime hosts, causing p99 to spike to ~550ms for 45 minutes
   - Impact: brief SLO miss for p99, customer-facing latency complaints from a small PLG cohort
   - Current status: rollback completed; PR to improve telemetry + stricter canary thresholds opened (PR#789)
   - Owner: Sofie Jensen (investigate root causes and update rollout playbook)
3) Noisy k8s node terminations (ongoing)
   - Summary: AWS host terminations in eu-west-1 causing pod reschedules and transient errors, correlated with higher pages for infra category
   - Mitigations in progress: reduce eviction sensitivity, increase pod disruption budgets for critical workloads
   - Owner: Aisha Patel (infra)

Monitoring / signal items (things to review during meeting)
- Prometheus alert rate: alert_firing_count increased 18% last week. Need to triage noisy alerts (candidate: kube_pod_evicted, kube_node_not_ready flapping)
- Add composite alert for "model-canary-degradation" that looks at p99 + error-rate for canary population (to reduce noise from single-host anomalies)
- Dashboard gaps: lack of a per-model-variant p95/p99 breakdown in the console. Request: product + console team to add lightweight per-variant chart (ticket: PROJ-332)

Runbooks / playbooks status
- model-variant rollback runbook: partial, missing clear checklist for cache warming + circuit-breaker thresholds
- db-failover playbook: exists but no pre-warm step for metadata cache. TODO to add pre-warm
- paging escalation matrix: outdated (missing new SRE hire names and rotation schedule). Update needed before next month

Action items (owner / due / notes)
- Liam: finalize DB failover postmortem + add pre-fail cache-warm steps (due 2026-03-17) [linked: SRE-492]
- Sofie: deep dive on quantized model rollout -> root cause + proposed fixes, update canary thresholds, link PR#789 (due 2026-03-13)
- Aisha: infra mitigations for node termination noise (PDBs + eviction tuning). Submit infra change request and validate on staging (due 2026-03-16)
- Priya: update paging escalation matrix with current rotation and contact info (due 2026-03-12)
- Priya/Liam: propose an SLO remediation plan if monthly availability remains below target (draft by 2026-03-20)
- Sofie + Console team (product): spec for per-model-variant p99 chart (ticket PROJ-332, due 2026-03-24)

Unresolved / discussion items
- Thresholds for canary rollouts: currently 10% traffic for 15 minutes. Should we tighten to 5% traffic and extend duration? Pros/cons to discuss
- Is there appetite to raise retention on slow request traces for 14d to help debugging p99 spikes? Cost impact estimate needed
- Should we open a dedicated "SRE reliability" retrospective soon that focuses solely on SLO misses and recurring paging noise? (propose 60-90m session next month)

Quick notes to self (scratchpad)
- Check with product on PROJ-332 ownership (who on console team?)
- Follow up with infra on staging validation times (avoid blocking Aisha)
- Remind on-call to annotate pages with suspected root cause in PagerDuty notes (helps for postmortems)

Meeting prep checklist (for Priya)
- Pull last 30d SLO graphs (Grafana) + export as PNG for deck
- Open postmortem draft and ensure owners assigned
- Prepare short blurb on paging trend increase with proposed short-term mitigations

End of notes.

Minor / informal: plenty of TODOs left, treat this as working doc. Will tidy before sending meeting invite summary.
